- packing dye into dye blocks with the Multiservo Press
- unpacking dye blocks into dye with the Multiservo Press
- using Plant Fibers as catalyst with the Phytogenic Insulator
- growing cactus and flower seeds with the Phytogenic Insulator
- duplicating cactus and flower plants with the Phytogenic Insulator
- grinding cactus and flower plants with the Pulverizer

releases.notes: - added missing recipe conditions to prevent logspam when compatibility mods are not installed (e.g. Create, Mekanism)

- crops are no longer flammable to match vanilla behaviour
- fully grown crops can now be harvested with silk touch to obtain their plant counterpart instead of their crop drops
- mobs now respect cactus crops, cactus plants and potted cactus plants as damage source (they therefore now adapt their pathing behaviour to walk around these blocks to avoid to get damage)
